summary: A multi-stage Python data pipeline (step2.py, step3.py, app.py) that builds a tabular synthetic-data generator: it defines SDV Metadata, trains an SDV CTGANSynthesizer on transformed data, and evaluates the output with SDV's evaluate_quality, while also calling RDT's ClusterBasedNormalizer and OneHotEncoder transformers directly. SDV (via sdv.single_table.CTGANSynthesizer, sdv.metadata.Metadata, sdv.evaluation.single_table.evaluate_quality) and RDT's transformers are run as the core synthetic-data generation and evaluation engine of the pipeline.
